To solve this problem, I need to first calculate the average call duration, then filter the data to include only subscribers with a call duration greater than the average, and finally select the subscriber ID and call duration.

Action: Operation
```sql
SELECT 
  subscriber_id, 
  call_duration
FROM call_detail_records
WHERE call_duration > (SELECT AVG(call_duration) FROM call_detail_records);
```
